menu_options.board: Add a plant board by its address

zeroconf_confirm.title: A plant board was found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Board {id}, at {host}. Give it a name: its entities are named after it.

data_description.name: Such as the plant it looks after

board.title: Add a plant board
board.description: Its address (IPv6, without brackets) and a name. The board is asked for its ID, so it must answer.

fleet_manager.title: Connect the fleet manager
fleet_manager.description: The fleet manager (the ha-coap-server app) updates the boards' firmware. In it: Settings, Other devices, make a link with "For the HA CoAP integration" ticked, then paste its address and key here. Each board then has a firmware update in Settings, Updates.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: A board's new address (it must be the same board), or the fleet manager's address and key.

error.no_device_id: The board answered without a device ID: update its firmware
error.another_board: Another board answers at this address
error.invalid_auth: The fleet manager refused the key: make a new link for Home Assistant in it

abort.already_configured: This is added already (its address was updated)
abort.no_device_id: This device has no board ID in its name or its TXT record

init.title: {name} doesn't answer
init.description: {name} hasn't answered at {host} for a day.

menu_options.address: It has a new address (after a new border router)
menu_options.off: It's off for now: no issue until it answers again

address.title: {name}'s new address
address.description: A new border router gives every board a new address: give its new one (the fleet manager shows it).

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.description: {name}, its device and its entities are removed from Home Assistant.

error.no_device_id: The board answered without a device ID
error.another_board: Another board answers at this address

not_a_pump.message: Only a board's Run the pump button waters: choose that one

water.name: Water
water.description: Runs a board's pump, for a given time or its run time. Its run time setting doesn't change.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long the pump runs, 1 to 9 s. Empty: its run time.
